case_schema.ability: string, required: knowledge-update or temporal (the LongMemEval ability names, as used by scripts/wiki_longmem_eval.py)
case_schema.expected: string, required, non-null: the correct answer's key tokens (this slice has no abstention cases; abstention stays with the pinned battery)
case_schema.expected_as_of: string, required (YYYY-MM-DD): the date of the session the correct answer rests on — for knowledge-update, the superseding session's date
case_schema.forbidden: list of strings, required, non-empty: superseded or cue-excluded values that must not be given as the current answer
case_schema.id: string, required, unique across the slice (LMU-KU<n> / LMU-TR<n>)
case_schema.question: string, required
case_schema.sessions: list, required, non-empty: {id, timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD), turns: [string]} in chronological order
case_schema.slice_class: string, required: knowledge-update or temporal, equal to ability
case_schema.superseding_session: string, required for knowledge-update (the id of the session that supersedes), absent for temporal

case_requirements: at least two sessions with strictly increasing timestamps
expected states value B and its tokens appear in the superseding session's turns
forbidden names value A and its tokens appear in an earlier session's turns but not in expected
classes.expected_behaviour: Answer B, the superseding value, dated by the superseding session (expected_as_of is that session's date): the answer must reflect the superseding ingest, not the first statement of the fact.
classes.forbidden_behaviour: Answering A, the superseded value, or presenting A and B as equally current.
classes.name: answer-reflects-superseding-ingest
classes.question_shape: A question about the fact, asked in the present tense, whose correct answer changed when the superseding session landed.
staging_sequence: an earlier dated session states value A for a fact
a later dated session supersedes it, stating value B for the same fact
the question is asked after both sessions

case_requirements: at least two sessions with distinct timestamps
the question contains a temporal cue from the slice's cue list
expected's tokens appear in some session's turns
forbidden names a value from a session the cue excludes
classes.expected_behaviour: Answer the value from the session the cue selects, with that session's date as the answer's as-of.
classes.forbidden_behaviour: Answering the value of a session the cue excludes — above all, answering the most recent value when the cue asks for the first, or the first when it asks for the most recent.
classes.name: answer-follows-the-temporal-cue
classes.question_shape: A question whose temporal cue, not recency, decides which session's value is the answer.
staging_sequence: two or more dated sessions state different values for a fact at different times
the question carries an explicit temporal cue (first / earliest / last / most recent / before / after / in <period>) selecting one session

note: Fixture cases live in evaluation/longmem-update-temporal-cases.jsonl, in the case format scripts/wiki_longmem_eval.py already validates and scores (id, ability, sessions, question, expected), plus this slice's own fields (slice_class, expected_as_of, superseding_session, forbidden). Staging real questions against live pages and scoring composed answers are separate future acts under their own approval; this register defines the classes and pins the fixture shape.
pattern: LongMemEval (Wu et al. 2024) knowledge-update and temporal-reasoning abilities, restated in this wiki's own vocabulary over its own registers, as a SEPARATE slice in the extended-set family (beside evaluation/extended-questions.jsonl, scored in the same spirit as evaluation/longmem-fixtures.jsonl). Definitions and case schema only: no LongMemEval dataset material is imported, no case here is drawn from that dataset, and neither the golden set (evaluation/golden-questions.jsonl) nor the pinned 12-case abstention battery (evaluation/abstention-battery.jsonl) is part of or modified by this slice — the battery stays byte-stable and this slice lands beside it.
